title: E8 Lattice Alignment — v4.0 pre-registered confirmatory set
statistical_note: Primary statistic: search-aware best-of-search RMS null (1000 trials per seed). BH-FDR applied at q=0.05 to the pre-registered 12-seed elite family; controls tested separately. Distance color bins are display conventions, not significance thresholds. The signal is statistically robust at the family level; the mechanism is unknown.

display_bins.note: Display bins only. Not significance thresholds.
